objective: Align the RR registry's active entry metadata with its own trained artifact. models/rr_registry.json entry 202605_bnb_v2_bnbusdt declared n_features:35 while the artifact it points at (models/rr_model_202605_bnb_v2.json) declares n_features:38. active_models.yaml faithfully mirrored the incorrect registry value (authority: mirror_of_registry), so the defect had to be corrected UPSTREAM in the registry, with the YAML mirror following only because the registry changed. Metadata-only: no artifact is rewritten, no loader, config, or runtime wiring is touched.
change_class_rationale: MODEL_ARTIFACT_CHANGE is the class whose declared surface includes 'models/ registry manifests'. No other class claims models/*_registry.json. The change edits a registry manifest field only; it adds/replaces no serialized model.

artifact_declares.note: 38 - 11 zero_indices = 27, matching F-044's rank-27 Mahalanobis dof

evidence.trainer_constant: src/config_layer/rr/rr_pattern_miner.py:22 -> N_FEATURES = CANONICAL_FEATURE_DIM = 38; a re-run today would write 38

behaviour_impact.reason: engine_runner.rr_fusion.enabled=false, so no inference path reads this registry. The only runtime reader of the field is src/control_plane/dashboard_api.py:492 (entry.get('n_features', 35)), a display consumer; the edit corrects what the dashboard shows.

deliberately_out_of_scope: Six other rr_registry entries also declare n_features:35; four of them are dangling (model_file missing under all three path resolutions) and cannot be verified against any artifact. Changing unverifiable metadata would be inventing data.

The same entry's n_samples:0 alongside metrics.n_train:49000. Zero is certainly wrong, but the true total sample count is unknown (train split != total) and will not be guessed. Recorded as an open item.
tradenet identity feature_schema_dim:35 - the artifact is a binary .pth and the registry carries no dim field, so the declaration is UNVERIFIABLE without torch.
authority: Corrects metadata to match a verified artifact. Grants no promote, enable, retrain, or wiring right (CLAUDE.md 6.5). rr_fusion remains enabled:false.
